from qiskit.circuit.library import QAOASolver
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA, L_BFGS_B
from qiskit.transpile import pass_through

    creg = ClassicalRegister(len(graph_vertices), name='c')
    qc = QuantumCircuit(qreg, creg)

    adj_matrix = nx.adjacency_matrix(G).todense()
    degree_matrix = np.diag(np.sum(adj_matrix, axis=0)) - adj_matrix

        qc.clear()
        qc.h(qreg)
        for i in range(len(theta)):
            qc.ry(theta[i], qreg[i])
            for j in range(i+1, len(theta)):
                qc.cx(qreg[i], qreg[j])
        for i in range(len(chi)):
            qc.ry(-chi[i], qreg[i])
            for j in range(i+1, len(chi)):
                qc.cx(qreg[i], qreg[j])
        qc.measure(qreg, creg)

        # Calculate the expectation value of the cost function
        result = execute(qc, Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator'), shots=final_shots).result()
        counts = result.get_counts(qc)
        cost_val = np.sum([counts[k] * np.power(2, len(k) - np.count_nonzero(k)) for k in counts])

        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "reproducibility": repro_scores.mean()
    }

def modularity(G, partition):
    Q = np.zeros((len(G), len(G)))
